ns2:course.label: Ed Prac in EC & EIEd
ns2:course.description: Course in practice teaching to meet certification requirements for teaching in the elementary school. 2 to 12 undergraduate hours. 2 to 12 graduate hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: CI 420 or CI 406 as required by the student's curriculum; Satisfactory completion of all requirements of the Council on Teacher Education Undergraduate or Graduate Common Assessment Plan for Initial Certification (http://cote.illinois.edu/).
